title: AutoPlay profile
description: profile.json: a group of screens and sequences belonging to one target application.

name.description: Display name, unique among profiles (ignoring case).

lastTargetRegion.description: Last region framed for recording or execution, in physical screen pixels; null if none yet.

defaults.description: Execution settings used when a step or location does not override them.

verificationTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for a location to appear, in milliseconds.

retryIntervalMs.description: Time between two verification attempts, in milliseconds.

matchThreshold.description: Minimum template matching score to accept a match.

searchMargin.description: Fraction of the location size added on each side to build the search area.

userTakeoverTolerancePx.description: Cursor distance, in pixels, beyond which a move is considered a user takeover.
